case_title.correct_value: Bhim Singh v. State of Uttarakhand
case_title.quote: one Bhim Singh S/o of Govind Singh, resident of Village Naliana
case_title.reason: Body text and running heads say Bhim Singh; the 'Shim' form appears to be a scan or typo error.

number_of_accused.reason: Court decides liability of appellants 1 and 2; the other two were acquitted by the High Court.

accused_gender.reason: The two appellants whose liability is upheld are male brothers.

accused_occupation.reason: Defence counsel's submission on occupations is accurately reported.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on the accused's wealth or class.

victim_gender.reason: Victim was a married woman, Prema Devi.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Husband, his brothers and a brother's wife, as described.

statutory_provisions.reason: Sections match the convictions and presumptions discussed.

weapon.reason: Poison found in viscera and burning are the means alleged.

confession.reason: Only s.313 admissions of marriage and unnatural death.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Accurate, and flags the judgment's internal inconsistency on the 498-A term.

offence_finally_established.correct_value: IPC s.304-B and s.498-A; Dowry Prohibition Act ss.3 and 4 (appellants 1 and 2)
offence_finally_established.quote: convicted appellant Nos.1 & 2 herein under Section 304-B of IPC ... all the appellants were also convicted under Sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act
offence_finally_established.reason: Omits the 498-A and Dowry Prohibition Act convictions that also stand.

imprisonment_years.reason: Main sentence is life, not a fixed term.

fine_rs.quote: rigorous imprisonment for one year and a fine of Rs.500/- to each of them
fine_rs.reason: A fine of Rs.500 was imposed and upheld, so null is wrong.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Same summary without gendered pronouns such as 'his brothers' and 'his brother's wife'.
neutral_facts.quote: her husband Bhim Singh, Aan Singh, Nain Singh, all sons of Govind Singh and Smt. Janki Devi wife of Aan Singh
neutral_facts.reason: Content accurate and outcome-neutral, but uses gendered pronouns for the accused, against the instructions.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment does not state the statutory maximum; null equals Not stated.

physical_harm.reason: 90% skin-deep burns, poison in viscera, death.

number_of_offences.reason: Four sections charged; all upheld for appellants 1 and 2.

premeditation_planning.reason: No explicit premeditation finding; only opportunity noted.

motive.reason: Dowry harassment accepted; unrecovered expenses complaint noted.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Matches evidence relied on in paras 12-13.

witness_credibility.reason: Court accepted the relatives' evidence and rejected the defence points.

investigation_status.reason: FIR, investigation, charge-sheet, committal and trial all described.

procedural_irregularity.reason: Charge defect argument was rejected; no lapse noted.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Cases and citations match the judgment.

judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: We, therefore, find no infirmity in the impugned judgment passed by the High Court.
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Listed facts are guilt reasoning, not aggravating factors weighed for sentence.

other_sentence_order.reason: Only no order as to costs.
